purpose: Only artifacts actually installed in a verified image may back a declared capability. A declaration without evidence is invalid; an installer must not synthesize a capability from source presence or a build plan.
notes: An older frontend package installs the megadriver as libgallium.so under /usr/lib/floe-gpu/dri with LIBGL_DRIVERS_PATH; a new declaration must use the exact installed filename and cannot reuse this policy's frontend entry unchanged.
video.nativeSoftware is native software encoding/decoding, not GPU or hardware acceleration; it must never be presented as hardware.
Blender is an application workload, not a capability. Do not add a Blender flag to image manifests.
OpenCL remains unavailable until an admitted compiler and a real ICD load are recorded.
